events.name: Bash
events.head: Regenerate hub, grep for stale strings, check git state
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "--- grep"; for f in workshop-plan/index.html live/index.html; do echo "$f LC=$(grep -c 'Launch Control' $f) sec=$(grep -c '<section id="tasks"' $f) chap=$(grep -ci 'chaperone' $f) d1prove=$(grep -c 'd1-prove' $f)"; done; echo "--- git"; git status --short -- workshop-plan/index.html live/index.html workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py; git log --oneline -3 -- workshop-plan/index.html workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py; git fetch -q origin 2>&1 | tail -2; git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...main; git check-ignore -v live/

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the d-prove step, tasks redirect code, and publish hold log
events.input: $ grep -n "d-prove\|d-ship\|#tasks\|tasks.html" workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py | head -30; echo ---; grep -rn "Launch Control" workshop-plan/build/ | head -5; echo "--- hold"; tail -15 /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-300 | grep -i -n "hold" | tail -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the hub link probe and compare the live page with the local hub
events.input: $ grep -n -o ".\{120\}tasks\.html.\{80\}" workshop-plan/index.html | grep -i "hash\|location" | head -5; echo "--- probe"; (cd app && node scripts/probe-review-hub.mjs 2>&1 | tail -5); echo "--- live"; curl -sL "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/?v=$(date +%s)" -o /tmp/t150-live.html; cmp /tmp/t150-live.html workshop-plan/index.html && echo IDENTICAL; echo "LC=$(grep -c 'Launch Control' /tmp/t150-live.html) sec=$(grep -c '<section id="tasks"' /tmp/t150-live.html) chap=$(grep -ci chaperone /tmp/t150-live.html) d3=$(grep -c 'playbook/d3' /tmp/t150-live.html)"; grep -o '"d-prove"[^]]
